title: String Length
statement: Given a string s, return its length without using the built-in Length property in the core logic.
think: What is the task asking? Count how many characters the string contains.
What is the key operation? Increment a counter once per character.
What wording signals stand out? Length, count characters.
What is the brute force idea? There is no simpler approach than scanning once.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass with a counter.
What are the edge cases? Empty string.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I iterate through each character and increment a counter.
algorithm: Iterate through each character in s
interview: I would solve it with a simple linear scan and increment a counter for each character.
ru: Это самая базовая задача на проход по строке: один символ — один инкремент счётчика.

critical: Use built-in Length when the task forbids it
nice: Do not explain why this is O(n)

gaps: Important: be comfortable with basic string iteration
constraints: Assume ordinary ASCII/UTF-16 char iteration is acceptable.
whyThisPattern: This is a basic counting scan: read each character once and increment a counter.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because frequencies are not needed.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no left/right action.
